'''Elan Mak's Podracer''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] model owned by the [[Fluggrian/Legends|Fluggrian]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kam Nale]]&mdash;otherwise known as Elan Mak. He piloted his vehicle during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve]] and the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]].
